title: rgba() values throughout NewStartPage sub-components
body: Many hardcoded rgba() values remain across the extracted sub-components (SimulationSection, ComparisonSection, CtaSection, StatsSection, NavigationBar, HeroSection, plus Chat tab in TabsSection). E.g. rgba(14,165,233,0.2), rgba(168,85,247,0.2), rgba(255,255,255,0.8). These should be replaced with Tailwind classes or CSS custom properties for design system consistency. TabsSection Notebook tab fixed in this PR. Run: grep -n 'rgba(' src/app/(frontend)/start/_components/NewStartPage/
rationale: Hardcoded rgba() values bypass the design token system and make theme changes difficult.

title: E2E test gaps — onboarding overlay and tab switching not covered
body: The existing test suite (tests/e2e/start-redesign.e2e.spec.ts) is missing: (1) onboarding overlay dismissal flow, (2) tab switching between dashboard/chat/notebook, (3) full simulation message exchange with multiple messages.
rationale: Review item 9 from the specialist review explicitly flagged missing E2E coverage.

title: Dead gradient tokens in tailwind.tokens.mjs — FIXED in this PR
body: 11 gradient tokens in tailwind.tokens.mjs (sky-purple, sky-blue, purple-indigo, etc.) were wired into tailwind.config.mjs theme.extend.backgroundImage via CSS variable references (var(--gradient-sky-purple), etc.) as of this PR. The inline style={{ background: 'var(--gradient-sky-purple)' }} pattern can now optionally be replaced with className='bg-gradient-sky-purple' in future work.
rationale: Item 3 of the UI/UX review feedback addressed in this PR.
